outcome_statement: A requireKey-gated route sends a plain-text email via the server's own configured Postmark credentials, so the founder can be emailed a link (e.g. the Android install URL) without any cross-platform share mechanism.
pain: Apple device cannot AirDrop/share a URL directly to an Android device -- needs the system to email it instead.
value: General-purpose founder-notify-by-email capability, reusable for any future need to get a link or short message to Adam's inbox.
success_metrics: POST with real creds returns ok:true and a Postmark message_id
failure_metrics: Secret token echoed in any response
constraints: Never log or return the raw POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN
unacceptable_result: Any change beyond the single email-send route
ownership: ARC emits machine twin; Builder executes; Adam owns founder usability verdict

point_model.A: Vision -- Adam provides FP in development stage
point_model.B: Chair locks handoff -- corridor protected; Adam done until Alpha
